title: Nvidia customers notified about AI-related price hikes above 15%, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，Nvidia 客户收到有关 AI 相关价格上涨 15% 以上的通知
summary: Some of Nvidia's largest customers have been told prices of servers ‌containing its AI chips will rise by ‌more than 15% in many cases with memory chip ​costs soaring, Bloomberg News reported on Saturday.
summary_zh: 据彭博社周六报道，Nvidia 的一些最大客户已被告知，随着内存芯片成本飙升，包含其 AI 芯片的服务器价格在许多情况下将上涨 15% 以上。

title: Tariff refunds are hitting retailers' wallets. Here's what they're doing with the money.
title_zh: 关税退款正在打击零售商的钱包。这就是他们用这笔钱做的事情。
summary: Companies are using tariff refunds to lower prices, cushion their margins, and, to a very small extent, return the money straight to the customer.
summary_zh: 公司利用关税退款来降低价格、缓冲利润，并在很小的程度上将钱直接返还给客户。
